method: Node VM with in-memory fake Web Storage and minimal DOM. Rendering functions replaced with no-ops and selected closure functions exposed in memory. Source files unchanged; no real browser storage or services used.

results.name: Session validation positive and tamper control
results.expected: Valid session accepted; role-only alteration rejected
results.actual: Valid manager session accepted; altered role rejected.

results.name: Authentication boundary
results.expected: Unauthenticated write guard rejects; no public helper can establish trusted authority
results.actual: guardWrite without session=true; public session helper accepted stored account=true

results.name: Credential hash known vectors
results.expected: SHA-256 output matches Node crypto for empty, ASCII and Unicode inputs
results.actual: All three vectors matched. This is correctness evidence, not password-storage security.

results.name: Attendance calculation
results.expected: 08:15-18:00 gives 15 late and 60 overtime minutes; absent gives zero

results.name: Attendance chronology
results.expected: Reject same-day time out earlier than time in

results.name: Duplicate attendance
results.expected: Reject second attendance record for same employee/date
results.actual: Second record rejected by submit handler.

results.name: Payroll period policy
results.expected: Accept only valid semi-monthly periods or calculate basic pay consistently for custom ranges
results.actual: One-day, 14-day, 30-day ranges all basic=13000, 13000, 13000; attendance count zero.

results.name: Overlapping payroll
results.expected: Reject overlapping payroll for same employee

results.name: Paid payroll immutability
results.expected: Paid payroll remains immutable or requires explicit adjustment/reversal
results.actual: Saved paid amount changed from 9000 to 13000; status=Paid; range=2026-10-10..2026-10-20

results.name: Approved leave delete consistency
results.expected: Deleting approved leave follows a policy and reconciles generated attendance
results.actual: Leave live=0; trash=1; generated On Leave attendance remains=2

results.name: Employee identifier lifecycle
results.expected: New employee ID never reuses deleted identity referenced by history/accounts
results.actual: nextEmployeeId=EMP-001; deleted employee and historical payroll still refer to EMP-001.

results.name: Employee account lifecycle
results.expected: Inactive or missing linked employee invalidates employee access
results.actual: Session accepted with inactive employee=true; missing employee=true.

results.name: Primary account migration
results.expected: Existing manager credentials preserved by ordinary startup
results.actual: Existing custom password overwritten=true; username reset=true when migration flag absent.

results.name: Backup round trip and malformed restore
results.expected: Valid backup restores coherently; malformed record types rejected before any write
results.actual: Static review only; no filesystem download/upload or full Settings DOM exercised.

results.name: Browser navigation, synchronization and printing
results.expected: Login, cross-tab updates, popup print and browser persistence work end to end
results.actual: No live browser session; VM checks do not verify DOM, browser events, layout or print.
